name: Fists Up
description:
You may make one attack per free hand each turn.

When you make unarmed attacks or attack with an improvised weapon, your damage die for the attack is a d6.

Describe how your stripped-down style delivers a brutal blow.

improvements.name: Fists of Fury
improvements.description: Your damage die for unarmed attacks and attacks with improvised weapons increases to a d8.

improvements.name: Sting Like A Bee
improvements.description: Your damage die for unarmed attacks and attacks with improvised weapons increases to a d10.
